LESSON: SLOPES AS SIMPLE MACHINES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.3: Slopes as simple machines

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Slopes as simple machines. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How are slopes used in everyday life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify types of slopes used as simple machines
2. demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify types of slopes used as simple machines
   In simple words: practise until you can identify types of slopes used as simple machines. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Slopes as simple machines using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Slopes as simple machines in the examples.
2. Explain Slopes as simple machines to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Slopes as simple machines.
4. Show that you can: identify types of slopes used as simple machines

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Slopes as simple machines using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Slopes as simple machines important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss with peers the meaning of slope as a simple machine (inclined plane),
2. Discuss with peers how slopes are used to make work easier in day-to-day life,
3. Citizenship: The learner exercises ethical responsibility as they make a simple slope for use in school or at home using locally available materials.
4. Ensure every learner actively participates in the activity
5. Observe learners as they carry out the CSL activity and record feedback

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify types of slopes used as simple machines
2. demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
